name: Voting Participation Method 3 Code
definition: Specifies the different methods allowed for participating to the vote of agenda resolutions in a general meeting.

MAIL.name: Correspondence
MAIL.definition: Vote participation is via documents sent through physical post / mail.

EVOT.name: Electronic Voting
EVOT.definition: Vote participation is through electronic means like dedicated standards messaging or web based voting applications.

PHYS.name: In Person
PHYS.definition: Vote participation is through physical attendance.

PHNV.name: Not Voting
PHNV.definition: Participation to the meeting is in person but the person is not voting.

PRXY.name: Proxy
PRXY.definition: Vote participation is through a proxy person.

VIRT.name: Virtual
VIRT.definition: Vote participation is through virtual meeting attendance method like multimedia and web based video or audio conferencing.
